# Sincere Glass (Xincheng Glass)

> Architectural glass manufacturer based in Wuhan, China, with 15+ years of domestic production experience and two factories totaling 20,000 m2 of floor space. We make tempered, insulated, laminated, Low-E, ceramic-frit (enameled), and curved tempered glass for facades, curtain walls, interiors, and specialty building applications worldwide. Our jumbo capability is 3.3m x 15m (both tempering furnace and laminating autoclave). Brand owners: Wuhan Xincheng Glass Co., Ltd. and Hubei Xinzhicheng Glass Co., Ltd.

Primary site: https://sincereglass.com
Spanish site: https://sincereglass.com/es/
Author / technical reviewer: Li Cheng, CEO at Sincere Glass (https://sincereglass.com/about)

## Company

- [About](https://sincereglass.com/about): Company history (2005-present), timeline, leadership, dual-factory structure, certifications overview.
- [Equipment](https://sincereglass.com/equipment): Production lines, cutting + edging + tempering + laminating + insulating equipment, capacity dashboard, process flow.
- [Projects](https://sincereglass.com/projects): Reference projects across transportation, commercial, residential, public, and cultural sectors (12 project cases).
- [Contact](https://sincereglass.com/contact): Factory addresses (Wuhan and Honghu), email, WhatsApp, business hours.

## Products

- [All Products](https://sincereglass.com/products): Full product line overview.
- [Tempered Glass](https://sincereglass.com/products/tempered-glass): Heat-strengthened architectural glass, 4-5x stronger than annealed, safe granular fragmentation. Jumbo size up to 3.3m x 15m.
- [Insulated Glass (IGU)](https://sincereglass.com/products/insulated-glass): Double / triple glazed units with argon fill and dual seal construction for thermal and acoustic insulation.
- [Laminated Glass](https://sincereglass.com/products/laminated-glass): PVB and SGP interlayer glass for safety, security, acoustic, and overhead glazing applications.
- [Enameled Glass](https://sincereglass.com/products/enameled-glass): Ceramic frit decorative glass with custom color palette and pattern gallery for facades and interior partitions.
- [Low-E Glass](https://sincereglass.com/products/low-e-glass): Low-emissivity coated glass (soft coat and hard coat) for energy-efficient building envelopes.
- [Curved Tempered Glass](https://sincereglass.com/products/curved-tempered-glass): Bent tempered glass, minimum bend radius 500mm, for curved facades and unique architectural forms.

## Blog — Technical Guides and Buyer Resources

Flat URL structure: /blog/[slug]. Five topic clusters, each anchored by a pillar page.

### Comparison cluster (pillar + articles)

- [Pillar: Architectural Glass Types Guide](https://sincereglass.com/blog/architectural-glass-types-guide): Decision framework for choosing between tempered, laminated, insulated, Low-E, and enameled glass by use case.
- [Tempered Glass vs Laminated Glass](https://sincereglass.com/blog/tempered-glass-vs-laminated-glass)
- [Insulated Glass vs Laminated Glass](https://sincereglass.com/blog/insulated-glass-vs-laminated-glass)
- [Tempered Glass vs Annealed Glass](https://sincereglass.com/blog/tempered-glass-vs-annealed-glass)
- [Curved Glass vs Flat Glass](https://sincereglass.com/blog/curved-glass-vs-flat-glass)

### Technical / Manufacturing cluster

- [How Is Tempered Glass Made](https://sincereglass.com/blog/how-is-tempered-glass-made)
- [How Is Laminated Glass Made](https://sincereglass.com/blog/how-is-laminated-glass-made)
- [How Is Insulated Glass Made](https://sincereglass.com/blog/how-is-insulated-glass-made)

### Application cluster

- [Pillar: Architectural Glass Applications Guide](https://sincereglass.com/blog/architectural-glass-applications-guide): Glass selection by building zone (facade, interior, balustrade, shower, skylight, floor) with code references.
- [Curtain Wall Glass Specification](https://sincereglass.com/blog/curtain-wall-glass-specification)
- [Shower Glass Thickness Guide](https://sincereglass.com/blog/shower-glass-thickness-guide)

### Buyer Guide cluster

- [How to Import Glass From China](https://sincereglass.com/blog/how-to-import-glass-from-china): Supplier verification, Incoterms, container loading, landed cost, and risk mitigation.

### Product Deep Dive cluster

- [Pillar: Architectural Glass Specification Guide](https://sincereglass.com/blog/architectural-glass-specification-guide): 6-attribute specification framework (type, thickness, coating, interlayer, treatment, dimensions) with capability matrix.
- [12mm Tempered Glass Specifications](https://sincereglass.com/blog/12mm-tempered-glass-specifications)
- [SGP vs PVB Interlayer Cost](https://sincereglass.com/blog/sgp-vs-pvb-interlayer-cost)

## Factory capability snapshot

- Total floor space: 20,000 m2 across two factories (Wuhan and Honghu, both in Hubei Province, China)
- 4 intelligent cutting lines
- 4 edge-grinding lines
- 2 tempering furnaces, maximum panel size 3.3m x 15m
- 2 high-pressure laminating autoclaves, one sized at 3.3m x 15m
- 2 insulated glass lines (one is ultra-large automatic gas-fill)
- 15+ years of domestic Chinese glass manufacturing experience
- First-time entry into international export markets (positioning emphasis on verified factory capability rather than export track record)

## Lead magnet

- [Global Architectural Glass Building Codes Comparison (PDF)](https://sincereglass.com/downloads/glass-building-codes-comparison.pdf): 11-page reference comparing US IBC/ASTM, EU EN, China GB, and Australia AS standards for tempered, laminated, insulated, and Low-E glass across application categories.
